summary: The statement and proof are correct with no mathematical gaps. The exact section formula establishes compactness, full dimension, base-evenness, and finite positive mixed-integer measure. The projection-width argument and contained segment parallelograms establish the area lower bound uniformly throughout one complete positive-length end interval for every area-one parallelogram. The final choice L > max{A,1} gives the asserted strict violation with the required quantifier order.
